summary: Maps a pit crew animation name string to an integer enum ID in the range 0-24. Normalizes the input string through sub_589901, then runs a chain of strcmp comparisons against the pit-crew animation string globals (jack, lollipop, fuel, wheels, and 10-second pit crew roles), returning the matching enum value. Returns 0 when the string matches the first entry or none of the entries.

local_names.lpSrcStr: pit crew animation name string to classify
local_names.result: default enum value 0 returned when no entry matches

operations.description: sub_589901(lpSrcStr) normalizes the input string before comparison
result defaults to 0; a match on the first string (aFrontJackUp at 0x005CD32C) falls through to this default
When strcmp(lpSrcStr, aFrontJackUp) is 0 the function returns the default 0
Chained strcmp returns 1-4 for aFrontJackDown, aRearJackUp, aRearJackDown, aLollipopDown
Chained strcmp returns 5-7 for aLollipopUp, aFuelIn, aFuelOut
Chained strcmp returns 8-12 for aFrontLeftWheel, aFrontRightWhee, aRearLeftWheel, aRearRightWheel, aRearRightWheel_0
Chained strcmp returns 13-16 for a10secLollipopD, a10secLollipopU, a10secFmanFleft, a10secNman
Chained strcmp returns 17-20 for a10secRman, a10secRman2, a10secSman, a10secSman2
Chained strcmp returns 21-22 for a10secSman3, a10secSman4; the trailing entry a10secStarterre returns 23 + (strcmp != 0), i.e. 24 on a match or 23 otherwise
Returns the matched enum ID, or the default 0 when no string matches; the sole recorded caller is sub_4A22D0 (004A22D0)
